explanation: Adjusted all four instance moves to x-axis only (eliminating the y=-36 component from the approved plan) to avoid introducing cascading M1.S.2, M2.S.2, V1.S.2, and V1.M1.EN.1 violations that arose when diagonal moves displaced instances off their standard-cell row grid.
